senses.gloss:
nauli
------------------------------------------
One of the षट्कर्मस् (six purificatory acts), नौलि consists in moving the muscles of the belly forcibly from the left to the right, in a wavy fashion. It removes dispep-sia and increases the power of digestion.
However, it is to be learnt and practised under expert guidance.
See also ṢAṬKARMAS.
